channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Sam Altman says OpenAI's latest job opening pays over half a million dollars a year and is 'stressful'
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warned on X that the job would be "stressful" and they'll need to "jump into the deep end pretty much immediately."

item.title: My grandmother wrote me a letter before my wedding. Her marriage advice insulted me at first, but now I get it.
item.description: My grandmother's wedding letter felt strange at first, but months later her warning shaped how I understand marriage, forgiveness, and real partnership.

item.title: These work besties ditched their corporate jobs and poured their savings into an athleisure brand
item.description: Tiffany Chng and Olivia Yiong were work besties. Both were laid off, so during the pandemic, they ditched corporate and launched an athleisure brand.

item.title: I'm a professional chocolatier. When cocoa prices spiked, I found ways to make better chocolate — not smaller bars.
item.description: When cocoa prices doubled, chocolatier Jerome Peñafort of Mr. Bucket Chocolaterie refused shrinkflation by finding new ways to innovate.

item.title: I left my Hollywood stunt career for 15 months to travel to 35 countries. I came back ready to plan my future beyond LA.
item.description: Sharonda Scott, now 37, set a rule not to spend more than $500 per plane ticket during her 15 months of travel.

item.title: Buckle up for more blizzard-induced flight delays across the East Coast and Midwest
item.description: Weather forecasters predict an onslaught of winter storms across the East Coast and the Midwest.

item.title: Kaley Cuoco says turning 40 gave her one big advantage in life and parenting
item.description: "You see things differently, and you understand people in a way you can't when you're 20 or 30," Kaley Cuoco said.

item.title: Rippling's product chief says this is why he deliberately understaffs every project
item.description: He said that working late and on weekends when a problem arises, and running a team to its capacity, is what separates good and great teams.

item.title: The 'Godfather of AI' warns 2026 will bring a new wave of AI job losses
item.description: Geoffrey Hinton says AI's rapid progress could trigger a new wave of job losses in 2026. "It's going to be able to replace many other jobs," he said.

item.title: The trade war is de-escalating and settling around 15% tariffs, Bank of America's CEO says
item.description: China and USMCA trade stand apart as special cases tied to security and policy.
